title: Fixed-scalar identity-factor evaluation of geometric compact support
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring and X, Z, Y Noetherian schemes. Let i:X→Z be a quasi-compact open immersion and p:Z→Y proper. For the compactifications ci=(i,id), cp=(id,p), c=(i,p), the pro-etale compositor of [lem-pur-compact-support-site-coherence] at a bounded-below etale object L equals the canonical identity-open unit followed by proper image of the identity-direct-image unit at ν_X^*L. The identity-open unit is obtained by deriving the left-adjoint identity isomorphism; the identity-direct-image unit is rightDerivedLowerStarId. Their pair is identityFactorFixedIso. All functors are ordinary fixed-Λ module sheaf functors of [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons]; there is no intrinsic coefficient presentation and no retained finite witness.

proof.text: Use the etale arbitrary-triangle formula for ci, cp and c, with both middle maps identity on Z. The middle square is Cartesian. Apply the identity exchange law, the right open-composition unit and the left proper-composition unit to evaluate the model compositor.

The normalized composition site square identifies the etale compositor with the pro-etale compositor. The extension-by-zero comparison respects the identity open unit; the direct-image counit mate respects the identity direct-image unit. Naturality of proper image pastes these two unit equations. Cancel the invertible source comparison to give the asserted fixed-scalar compositor equation.

theorem identityFactorFixedCompositor (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (i : X ⟶ Z) (p : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsProper p] [QuasiCompact i]
    (L : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    coherenceProEtaleCompositor Λ (Compactification.ofIsOpenImmersion i)
        (Compactification.ofIsProper p) (identityFactorPair i p) L =
      (identityFactorFixedIso Λ i p).hom.app ((coherenceBoundedSiteFunctor Λ X).obj L)
